archetype_description: Quiet, authoritative, high-contrast print aesthetic inspired by official bid cover sheets, industrial inspection certificates, and Gulf Coast maritime manifests. Built with crisp paper textures, technical grid borders, clear document stamps, and zero fluff.

ui_sans.usage: Headers, buttons, form controls, tabular labels, badges, navigational elements

report_serif.usage: Audit findings, executive summary copy, legal notices, sample report body

document_mono.usage: SKU codes, document tracking IDs, bid timestamps, matrix scores, file hashes

scale_rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase font-sans text-ink-black
scale_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight uppercase font-sans border-b border-industrial pb-2

layout_and_grid.document_container: max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-[#FAF8F5] border-2 border-[#111618] p-6 sm:p-10 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#111618]
layout_and_grid.grid_borders: border border-industrial divide-y md:divide-y-0 md:divide-x divide-industrial
layout_and_grid.corner_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (0px to 2px). Strictly avoid large pill/curved SaaS buttons.

visual_enhancers.stamps: Official document status badges resembling rubber stamps (e.g., 'VERIFIED QUALIFIED', 'AUDIT COMPLETE', 'BID READY')
visual_enhancers.watermarks: Subtle 5% opacity diagonal block print 'LOUISIANA INDUSTRIAL READINESS' background mark on report previews
visual_enhancers.hairlines: 1px solid #111618 or #D2CBBF dividers separating document headers and meta tables
visual_enhancers.paper_shadow: Hard offset 3px or 4px solid shadow (`shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#111618]`), no soft gradient drop shadows

products_sku_matrix.name: 48-Hour Qualification Audit
products_sku_matrix.description: Rigorous 10-point audit evaluating insurance, safety ratings, COI readiness, TWIC, licensing, and GC compliance.

products_sku_matrix.name: Industrial Proof Pack
products_sku_matrix.description: Comprehensive document compilation binder including certified company profile, safety program summary, insurance verification, and bid cover sheet.

products_sku_matrix.name: Bid Invite Response Desk
products_sku_matrix.description: Emergency bid response formatting, RFP compliance check, and rapid submittal assembly for Gulf Coast operators.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app maintains a crisp print/letterhead aesthetic with paper background (#F6F3EE), deep ink text (#111618), and Gulf blue (#0E3A5D) accent.
Use 1px dark borders and sharp rectangular boxes with hard shadow (shadow-[3px_3px_0px_0px_#111618]) for cards, tables, and buttons.
Ensure every interactive element and data display includes data-testid attributes for testing.

Implement client portal (/app) and admin portal (/admin) with live interactive state (mock/real data storage) for order queue, multi-category audit scoring, PDF memo generation, and public proof toggle.
Never use soft SaaS gradients or rounded pill elements. Keep typography dense, clear, and authoritative.
